ai.title: Alibaba Qwen Introduces QwenGyre: Elastic Reinforcement Learning RL for XLong-Horizon Agents
ai.brief: Alibaba’s Qwen team has introduced QwenGyre , an elastic reinforcement learning RL framework for extreme-long-horizon agent training. QwenGyre is an online reinforcement learning system from Alibaba that trains coding agents through unmodified, black-box harnesses. It targets rollouts that run for hours and process close to 1M tokens. 4T model. It rests on 2 core ideas. It moves idle GPUs between rollout and training. It also turns branching agent histories into bounded training samples. The research team defines ‘XLong-horizon’ tasks as agent runs spanning hours and hundreds of model and tool interactions. Examples include generating full repositories from specs, as in NL2Repo-Bench . QwenGyre splits GPUs into cells that share a training layout. Each cell can serve rollouts or host a full training replica. A core cell owns the authoritative weights and optimizer state. Satellite cells join training later.

sec.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Helpdesk 0-Days, Rogue Certs, ShinyHunters Arrest, AI-Fooling Malware and More
sec.brief: Some meetings last longer than it took attackers to jump on a newly disclosed security flaw this week. Within hours, they were already testing it. That's not much time to read the warning, let alone do something about it. But speed is only part of the problem. A secure connection didn't always mean a safe destination. People offering to fix a ransomware mess had questions to answer themselves.
